title: Law Minister Arjun Ram Meghwal (MoS, Independent Charge, Law and Justice) says the Centre plans a pilot of evening courts in Delhi, Bihar and Andhra Pradesh: day courts would sit a few extra hours in the evening for pending cases, retired judges expected to preside, run with the respective High Courts; no start date, hours, budget or court list (interview with The New Indian Express published 10 Nov 2026, via Bar & Bench and LawBeat 11 Nov; to reporters in Deoria 11 Nov, UNI). Pendency per Law Ministry Rajya Sabha written reply of 23 Jul 2026 (NJDG; data as of 16 Jul): about 5.64 crore cases in all courts; district and subordinate courts 4.98 crore; Supreme Court over 96,000, 26 pending 30+ years. Delhi district courts began evening sittings for pending traffic challans only in Dec 2024.
